objective: Thoughtful allocations/sliders against coherent competitive opponents; no robust engine/chassis-only winning shortcut.

pinned_audit_context.catalog: racing1.8.1 audit only; accepted target version must be explicit

blocking_prerequisites.requires: V2 requested identity resolves to V2 traits, explicit fixed player mode; no accidental legacy fallback in new profile
Accounted tire-management/correction effects in thermalV2, single-trait causality and identity-controlled noise
Versioned simulated mistake/incident law, ordinary pace noise distinguished, deterministic seeded exposure/recovery
Declared automatic load/physical limits and explicit fuel exhaustion; no tank inflation or censoring failed races
Era entry/exit snapshots, real earned budgets/HQ offsets/components/doctrines/unlocks from reducers and preparation
Freeze equations/profiles/cost and difficulty bands before full policy fitting

checks: no universally dominant archetype or max commitment

allocation_search.small_budget: all legal integer allocations for discretionary budget <=8
allocation_search.larger_budget: bounded deterministic space-filling shortlist and local integer transfers; not global optimum

slider_search.domain: actual player legal bounds/unlocks including endpoints
slider_search.refine: predeclared neighborhood after screening; freeze before reserved evaluation

checks: one-variable causal response before combined optimization
equal common budget, fixed HQ offsets
record actual effective points and components
thermals/grip/energy/fuel consequences, not unexplained time multipliers

fit_axes: driver traits and fixed commitment roles
legal compounds/stops and pacing policy if supported

stages.before_tuning: Freeze exact model/policy/corpus and decision thresholds
stages.covers: all public era1..5 calendars and real legal progression fixtures

deferred.reason: owner-deferred full-distance seam/physical issue; explicit exception, not PASS

requires: runtime/catalog/policy identity and independent verifier replay
stages.engineer: deterministic relevance/visibility after competition; no automatic one-event-one-LLM-call

incident_contract.initial_player_mode: explicit fixed balanced, no UI slider required
incident_contract.exposure: declared simulation time/distance, not render/telemetry samples
incident_contract.rng: pinned purpose-separated streams and stable competitor/exposure coordinates, checkpoint continuity
incident_contract.initial_scope: single-car mistake with actual future state/time/resource effects; retirement if explicitly supported
incident_contract.vsc: separate global-frontier/race-state integration before all affected futures commit
incident_contract.risk_coefficients: reduced game hypothesis, not industrial safety data

proposed_checks: reject robust engine/chassis shortcut dominating the eraI season across reserved fields
strict reproducible gain outside that family on technical/thermal cases above numerical uncertainty; field must exploit it
informed settings improve against same attainable field
reject always-best maximum commitment and archetypes
retain modest accepted early cooling effect
allow circuit-appropriate engine focus and occasional lucky wins; no forced four-axis spending
acceptance.win_rate_difficulty_bands: must be declared before fitting, not selected after results

operations.retain: compact diagnostics/identities/accepted actions and all failures; no default complete telemetry archive
operations.source_of_setup_and_physics: governed Rust and game preparation; no duplicated numerical laws in runner
